answer: One workable design: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because inlet only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, nebula is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any pigment approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
